html:
A wide picture at the top of a page, with an optional title on it. Phones and narrow windows get a second, tighter picture if one is given, so the subject does not become a thin strip.

Usage 

{{PageBanner
|image=Thunderwing_Titan_banner.jpg
|mobile=Thunderwing_Titan_banner_mobile.jpg
|title=Thunderwing Titan
|subtitle=Flying mount
}}

Only image is needed. Leave mobile out to use the same picture everywhere, and leave title out for a picture without text. Put it as the very first thing on the page, because it runs out to the outline of the content panel. Use |zoom=1.3 to zoom in on the picture (and |x= and |y=, 0 to 100, to move the centre of the zoom). Add |inset=yes to keep it inside the panel instead (for example when it is not at the top). Give the file name without File:.
